item.text: [{"task_id":"a57f2f04","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    empty = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    step = int(round(params['step'][0]))","    directions = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]","    out = grid.copy()","    if step <= 0 or background == empty:","        return out","    height, width = grid.shape","    visited = set()","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            if (row, col) in visited or grid[row, col] == background:","                continue","            cells = [(row, col)]","            visited.add((row, col))","            queue = [(row, col)]","            while queue:","                r, c = queue.pop()","                for dr, dc in directions:","                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","                    if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width and (nr, nc) not in visited and grid[nr, nc] != background:","                        visited.add((nr, nc))","                        queue.append((nr, nc))","                        cells.append((nr, nc))","            seeds = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if grid[r, c] != empty]","            if not seeds:","                continue","            top = min(r for r, c in seeds)","            bottom = max(r for r, c in seeds) + step","            left = min(c for r, c in seeds)","            right = max(c for r, c in seeds) + step","            tile_height = bottom - top","            tile_width = right - left","            for r, c in cells:","                sr = top + (r - top) % tile_height","                sc = left + (c - left) % tile_width","                out[r, c] = grid[sr, sc]","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"step":[1],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[8,0],"step":[1],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Each connected region inside the cyan background contains one seed tile. Extract its colored bounding rectangle, including internal black cells, and repeat it periodically throughout the region with the seed's original phase. Tensor values specify the background, empty color, inclusive bounding increment, and connectivity."}]
